source: HMRC Real Time Information via ONS — Payrolled employments in the UK by nationality, region and industrial sector, Tables 5-17 (Jul 2014 – Dec 2024 monthly time series). This file consolidates the latest-month snapshot and 5y change per region per industry.
caveat: Counts are EMPLOYMENTS not employees (a person with two jobs is counted twice). Industry breakdown is at SIC 2007 section level (A-U). Some cells are suppressed [c] and appear as missing here.
